review.notes: AliStore Staff is a retail back-office (ERP) app for electronics stores. Store staff use it for order processing, warehouse and service tasks, KPI, customer service, product intake and buyback. Access is role-based; a store provisions accounts for its own staff. App Review must receive an active demo staff account with representative non-production review data.
review.appReviewNotes:
Paste this text into App Store Connect > App Review Information > Notes.

WHAT THE APP IS
AliStore Staff is the back-office application of AliStore, a retail operations platform for electronics stores. Staff of a subscribing store use it to process orders, run warehouse and service work, follow their KPI, serve customers at the counter, accept incoming goods and handle buyback. Access is role-based and each store provisions accounts for its own staff, so an employee account is required to use the app.

DEMO ACCOUNT
Accounts are provisioned by each store from its ERP back office, so the app has no self-service registration by design. We created a dedicated review employee account for this submission and filled it into the Demo Account fields above.
The app opens on a sign-in screen with two fields, labelled in Russian: the first is the user name, the second is the matching sign-in credential. Enter exactly the two values from the Demo Account fields and tap the sign-in button. There is no one-time code step, no SMS, and nothing you need to request from us. Two-factor authentication is switched off on this account.
The account is loaded with representative non-production review data (sample orders, tasks and customers), so nothing you do in review affects a live store. If the account ever stops working during review, message us and we will re-issue it immediately.

WHAT TO EXPECT
Every money, stock and status action is written to an append-only audit ledger on our server; the review account is scoped to a review store, so its entries stay isolated from live retail operations. Face ID is optional and only unlocks an already signed-in session. Push notifications carry task and order assignments only. The app does not track users and ships a privacy manifest declaring NSPrivacyTracking=false.

CONTACT
Support: https://ali.kg/support. We monitor App Review messages continuously during review.

ru-KG.description: AliStore Staff — операционное ERP-приложение для розничных магазинов электроники. Персонал магазина обрабатывает заказы, выполняет складские и сервисные задачи, отслеживает KPI, обслуживает клиентов, принимает товары и ведёт операции скупки по регламентам магазина. Доступ ролевой: магазин выдаёт учётные записи своим сотрудникам.
